## Modules

- [ExGram](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.md): ExGram main supervisor that starts the bot's registry.
- [ExGram.Bot](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Bot.md): Bot creation helper.
- [ExGram.Bot.SetupCommands](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Bot.SetupCommands.md): Handles registering bot commands with the Telegram API,
expanding scopes and language variations.
- [ExGram.Bot.Supervisor](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Bot.Supervisor.md): Bot supervisor that starts the `ExGram.Dispatcher` and Updates processes.
- [ExGram.Bot.ValidateCommands](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Bot.ValidateCommands.md): Compile-time validation for bot command definitions.

- [ExGram.BotInit](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.BotInit.md): Behaviour for library-level bot initialization hooks.
- [ExGram.BotInit.GetMe](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.BotInit.GetMe.md): A `ExGram.BotInit` hook that calls `ExGram.get_me/1` at bot startup to
populate `bot_info` with the bot's `User` struct.
- [ExGram.BotInit.SetupCommands](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.BotInit.SetupCommands.md): A `ExGram.BotInit` hook that registers the bot's commands with Telegram at
startup.
- [ExGram.Cast](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Cast.md): Helper module to convert plain values returned from Telegram to ExGram models.
- [ExGram.Cnt](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Cnt.md): Context struct for ExGram request handling.
- [ExGram.Config](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Config.md): Configuration helper with environment variable support.
- [ExGram.Dispatcher](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Dispatcher.md): Named GenServer process that receives updates, applies middlewares for the bot,
and calls the bot's `c:ExGram.Handler.handle/2` callback.
- [ExGram.File](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.File.md): Helpers for working with Telegram file downloads.
- [ExGram.Handler](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Handler.md): Behaviour for handling updates in `ExGram.Bot` implementations.
- [ExGram.Markdown](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Markdown.md): Converts CommonMark/GFM Markdown into a `{plain_text, [MessageEntity]}` tuple
for the Telegram Bot API.
- [ExGram.Plug](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Plug.md): A Plug to handle incoming Telegram updates in webhook mode. It checks for the secret
token (if configured) and processes the update accordingly.
- [ExGram.Telemetry](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Telemetry.md): Telemetry integration for ExGram.
- [ExGram.Token](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Token.md): Helpers for working with bot tokens.
- [OpentelemetryExGram.Propagator](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/OpentelemetryExGram.Propagator.md): Captures and attaches OpenTelemetry context across process boundaries.

- DSL
  - [ExGram.Dsl](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Dsl.md): Mini DSL to build answers based on the context (`ExGram.Cnt`) easily.
  - [ExGram.Dsl.Keyboard](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Dsl.Keyboard.md): Keyboard DSL to create inline and reply keyboards easily.
  - [ExGram.Dsl.MessageEntityBuilder](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Dsl.MessageEntityBuilder.md): Composable builder for Telegram `ExGram.Model.MessageEntity` formatted messages.

- Middlewares
  - [ExGram.Middleware](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Middleware.md): Behaviour for creating middlewares.
  - [ExGram.Middleware.Builder](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Middleware.Builder.md): Macros for building bot middleware chains, commands, regex patterns, and init hooks.
  - [ExGram.Middleware.IgnoreUsername](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Middleware.IgnoreUsername.md): Middleware that strips the bot username from commands.

- Responses
  - [ExGram.Responses](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Responses.md): Responses protocol to create easier context flows

  - [ExGram.Responses.Answer](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Responses.Answer.md): Simple text answer response using `ExGram.send_message/3`.
  - [ExGram.Responses.AnswerCallback](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Responses.AnswerCallback.md): Answer callback query response using `ExGram.answer_callback_query/2`.
  - [ExGram.Responses.AnswerInlineQuery](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Responses.AnswerInlineQuery.md): Answer inline query response using `ExGram.answer_inline_query/3`.
  - [ExGram.Responses.DeleteMessage](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Responses.DeleteMessage.md): Delete message response using `ExGram.delete_message/3`.
  - [ExGram.Responses.EditInline](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Responses.EditInline.md): Edit inline message response using `ExGram.edit_message_text/2`.
  - [ExGram.Responses.EditMarkup](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Responses.EditMarkup.md): Edit markup response using `ExGram.edit_message_reply_markup/1`.
  - [ExGram.Responses.SendDocument](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Responses.SendDocument.md): Send document response, it uses `ExGram.send_document/3`

- Test
  - [ExGram.Adapter.Test](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Adapter.Test.md): HTTP Adapter for testing with per-process isolation using NimbleOwnership.
  - [ExGram.Test](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Test.md): ExGram testing conveniences.
  - [ExGram.Updates.Test](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Updates.Test.md): Updates implementation for testing purposes.

- Updates
  - [ExGram.Updates.Noup](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Updates.Noup.md): Updates implementation that just start a process but don't do anything

  - [ExGram.Updates.Polling](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Updates.Polling.md): Updates implementation using the polling method.
  - [ExGram.Updates.Webhook](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Updates.Webhook.md): Updates implementation using the webhook method.

- Adapters
  - [ExGram.Adapter](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Adapter.md): Behaviour for HTTP adapters.
  - [ExGram.Adapter.Req](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Adapter.Req.md): HTTP adapter that uses [Req](https://hexdocs.pm/req) for Telegram Bot API requests.
  - [ExGram.Adapter.Tesla](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Adapter.Tesla.md): HTTP adapter that uses [Tesla](https://hexdocs.pm/tesla) for Telegram Bot API requests.

- Encoder
  - [ExGram.Encoder](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Encoder.md): JSON encoder/decoder abstraction with pluggable engine support.
  - [ExGram.Encoder.Engine](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Encoder.Engine.md): Compiled encoder engine

  - [ExGram.Encoder.EngineCompiler](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Encoder.EngineCompiler.md): Dynamically compiles the `ExGram.Encoder.Engine` module with the selected engine.

- Macros
  - [ExGram.Macros](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Macros.md): `model/3` and `method/5` macros to build the API

  - [ExGram.Macros.Checker](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Macros.Checker.md): Type checker for the method executer.

  - [ExGram.Macros.Executer](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Macros.Executer.md): Executer for the method macro, it takes care of checking the parameters, fetching the token, building the path and body, and calling the adapter.

  - [ExGram.Macros.Helpers](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Macros.Helpers.md): Helpers for the ExGram.Macros module

- Models
  - [ExGram.Model](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.md): Telegram API Model structures

  - [ExGram.Model.AcceptedGiftTypes](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.AcceptedGiftTypes.md): This object describes the types of gifts that can be gifted to a user or a chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.AffiliateInfo](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.AffiliateInfo.md): Contains information about the affiliate that received a commission via this transaction.
  - [ExGram.Model.Animation](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Animation.md): This object represents an animation file (GIF or H.264/MPEG-4 AVC video without sound).
  - [ExGram.Model.Audio](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Audio.md): This object represents an audio file to be treated as music by the Telegram clients.
  - [ExGram.Model.BackgroundFill](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BackgroundFill.md): BackgroundFill model. Valid subtypes: BackgroundFillSolid, BackgroundFillGradient, BackgroundFillFreeformGradient

  - [ExGram.Model.BackgroundFillFreeformGradient](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BackgroundFillFreeformGradient.md): The background is a freeform gradient that rotates after every message in the chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.BackgroundFillGradient](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BackgroundFillGradient.md): The background is a gradient fill.
  - [ExGram.Model.BackgroundFillSolid](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BackgroundFillSolid.md): The background is filled using the selected color.
  - [ExGram.Model.BackgroundType](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BackgroundType.md): BackgroundType model. Valid subtypes: BackgroundTypeFill, BackgroundTypeWallpaper, BackgroundTypePattern, BackgroundTypeChatTheme

  - [ExGram.Model.BackgroundTypeChatTheme](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BackgroundTypeChatTheme.md): The background is taken directly from a built-in chat theme.
  - [ExGram.Model.BackgroundTypeFill](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BackgroundTypeFill.md): The background is automatically filled based on the selected colors.
  - [ExGram.Model.BackgroundTypePattern](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BackgroundTypePattern.md): The background is a .PNG or .TGV (gzipped subset of SVG with MIME type "application/x-tgwallpattern”) pattern to be combined with the background fill chosen by the user.
  - [ExGram.Model.BackgroundTypeWallpaper](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BackgroundTypeWallpaper.md): The background is a wallpaper in the JPEG format.
  - [ExGram.Model.Birthdate](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Birthdate.md): Describes the birthdate of a user.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotAccessSettings](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotAccessSettings.md): This object describes the access settings of a bot.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotCommand](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotCommand.md): This object represents a bot command.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotCommandScope](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotCommandScope.md): BotCommandScope model. Valid subtypes: BotCommandScopeDefault, BotCommandScopeAllPrivateChats, BotCommandScopeAllGroupChats, BotCommandScopeAllChatAdministrators, BotCommandScopeChat, BotCommandScopeChatAdministrators, BotCommandScopeChatMember

  - [ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeAllChatAdministrators](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeAllChatAdministrators.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering all group and supergroup chat administrators.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeAllGroupChats](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeAllGroupChats.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering all group and supergroup chats.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeAllPrivateChats](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeAllPrivateChats.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering all private chats.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeChat](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeChat.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering a specific chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeChatAdministrators](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeChatAdministrators.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering all administrators of a specific group or supergroup chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeChatMember](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeChatMember.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering a specific member of a group or supergroup chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeDefault](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotCommandScopeDefault.md): Represents the default scope of bot commands. Default commands are used if no commands with a narrower scope are specified for the user.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotDescription](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotDescription.md): This object represents the bot's description.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotName](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotName.md): This object represents the bot's name.
  - [ExGram.Model.BotShortDescription](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BotShortDescription.md): This object represents the bot's short description.
  - [ExGram.Model.BusinessBotRights](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BusinessBotRights.md): Represents the rights of a business bot.
  - [ExGram.Model.BusinessConnection](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BusinessConnection.md): Describes the connection of the bot with a business account.
  - [ExGram.Model.BusinessIntro](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BusinessIntro.md): Contains information about the start page settings of a Telegram Business account.
  - [ExGram.Model.BusinessLocation](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BusinessLocation.md): Contains information about the location of a Telegram Business account.
  - [ExGram.Model.BusinessMessagesDeleted](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BusinessMessagesDeleted.md): This object is received when messages are deleted from a connected business account.
  - [ExGram.Model.BusinessOpeningHours](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BusinessOpeningHours.md): Describes the opening hours of a business.
  - [ExGram.Model.BusinessOpeningHoursInterval](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.BusinessOpeningHoursInterval.md): Describes an interval of time during which a business is open.
  - [ExGram.Model.CallbackGame](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.CallbackGame.md): A placeholder, currently holds no information. Use BotFather to set up your game.
  - [ExGram.Model.CallbackQuery](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.CallbackQuery.md): This object represents an incoming callback query from a callback button in an inline keyboard. If the button that originated the query was attached to a message sent by the bot, the field message will be present. If the button was attached to a message sent via the bot (in inline mode), the field inline_message_id will be present. Exactly one of the fields data or game_short_name will be present.
  - [ExGram.Model.Chat](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Chat.md): This object represents a chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatAdministratorRights](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatAdministratorRights.md): Represents the rights of an administrator in a chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatBackground](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatBackground.md): This object represents a chat background.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatBoost](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatBoost.md): This object contains information about a chat boost.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatBoostAdded](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatBoostAdded.md): This object represents a service message about a user boosting a chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatBoostRemoved](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatBoostRemoved.md): This object represents a boost removed from a chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatBoostSource](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatBoostSource.md): ChatBoostSource model. Valid subtypes: ChatBoostSourcePremium, ChatBoostSourceGiftCode, ChatBoostSourceGiveaway

  - [ExGram.Model.ChatBoostSourceGiftCode](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatBoostSourceGiftCode.md): The boost was obtained by the creation of Telegram Premium gift codes to boost a chat. Each such code boosts the chat 4 times for the duration of the corresponding Telegram Premium subscription.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatBoostSourceGiveaway](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatBoostSourceGiveaway.md): The boost was obtained by the creation of a Telegram Premium or a Telegram Star giveaway. This boosts the chat 4 times for the duration of the corresponding Telegram Premium subscription for Telegram Premium giveaways and prize_star_count / 500 times for one year for Telegram Star giveaways.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatBoostSourcePremium](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatBoostSourcePremium.md): The boost was obtained by subscribing to Telegram Premium or by gifting a Telegram Premium subscription to another user.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatBoostUpdated](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatBoostUpdated.md): This object represents a boost added to a chat or changed.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatFullInfo](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatFullInfo.md): This object contains full information about a chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatInviteLink](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatInviteLink.md): Represents an invite link for a chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatJoinRequest](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatJoinRequest.md): Represents a join request sent to a chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatLocation](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatLocation.md): Represents a location to which a chat is connected.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatMember](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatMember.md): ChatMember model. Valid subtypes: ChatMemberOwner, ChatMemberAdministrator, ChatMemberMember, ChatMemberRestricted, ChatMemberLeft, ChatMemberBanned

  - [ExGram.Model.ChatMemberAdministrator](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatMemberAdministrator.md): Represents a chat member that has some additional privileges.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatMemberBanned](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatMemberBanned.md): Represents a chat member that was banned in the chat and can't return to the chat or view chat messages.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatMemberLeft](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatMemberLeft.md): Represents a chat member that isn't currently a member of the chat, but may join it themselves.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatMemberMember](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatMemberMember.md): Represents a chat member that has no additional privileges or restrictions.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatMemberOwner](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatMemberOwner.md): Represents a chat member that owns the chat and has all administrator privileges.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatMemberRestricted](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatMemberRestricted.md): Represents a chat member that is under certain restrictions in the chat. Supergroups only.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatMemberUpdated](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatMemberUpdated.md): This object represents changes in the status of a chat member.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatOwnerChanged](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatOwnerChanged.md): Describes a service message about an ownership change in the chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatOwnerLeft](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatOwnerLeft.md): Describes a service message about the chat owner leaving the chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatPermissions](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatPermissions.md): Describes actions that a non-administrator user is allowed to take in a chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatPhoto](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatPhoto.md): This object represents a chat photo.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChatShared](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChatShared.md): This object contains information about a chat that was shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestChat button.
  - [ExGram.Model.Checklist](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Checklist.md): Describes a checklist.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChecklistTask](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChecklistTask.md): Describes a task in a checklist.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChecklistTasksAdded](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChecklistTasksAdded.md): Describes a service message about tasks added to a checklist.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChecklistTasksDone](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChecklistTasksDone.md): Describes a service message about checklist tasks marked as done or not done.
  - [ExGram.Model.ChosenInlineResult](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ChosenInlineResult.md): Represents a result of an inline query that was chosen by the user and sent to their chat partner.
  - [ExGram.Model.Contact](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Contact.md): This object represents a phone contact.
  - [ExGram.Model.CopyTextButton](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.CopyTextButton.md): This object represents an inline keyboard button that copies specified text to the clipboard.
  - [ExGram.Model.Dice](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Dice.md): This object represents an animated emoji that displays a random value.
  - [ExGram.Model.DirectMessagePriceChanged](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.DirectMessagePriceChanged.md): Describes a service message about a change in the price of direct messages sent to a channel chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.DirectMessagesTopic](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.DirectMessagesTopic.md): Describes a topic of a direct messages chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.Document](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Document.md): This object represents a general file (as opposed to photos, voice messages and audio files).
  - [ExGram.Model.EncryptedCredentials](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.EncryptedCredentials.md): Describes data required for decrypting and authenticating EncryptedPassportElement. See the Telegram Passport Documentation for a complete description of the data decryption and authentication processes.
  - [ExGram.Model.EncryptedPassportElement](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.EncryptedPassportElement.md): Describes documents or other Telegram Passport elements shared with the bot by the user.
  - [ExGram.Model.ExternalReplyInfo](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ExternalReplyInfo.md): This object contains information about a message that is being replied to, which may come from another chat or forum topic.
  - [ExGram.Model.File](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.File.md): This object represents a file ready to be downloaded. The file can be downloaded via the link https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<file_path>. It is guaranteed that the link will be valid for at least 1 hour. When the link expires, a new one can be requested by calling getFile.
  - [ExGram.Model.ForceReply](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ForceReply.md): Upon receiving a message with this object, Telegram clients will display a reply interface to the user (act as if the user has selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'). This can be extremely useful if you want to create user-friendly step-by-step interfaces without having to sacrifice privacy mode. Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a user account.
  - [ExGram.Model.ForumTopic](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ForumTopic.md): This object represents a forum topic.
  - [ExGram.Model.ForumTopicClosed](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ForumTopicClosed.md): This object represents a service message about a forum topic closed in the chat. Currently holds no information.
  - [ExGram.Model.ForumTopicCreated](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ForumTopicCreated.md): This object represents a service message about a new forum topic created in the chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.ForumTopicEdited](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ForumTopicEdited.md): This object represents a service message about an edited forum topic.
  - [ExGram.Model.ForumTopicReopened](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ForumTopicReopened.md): This object represents a service message about a forum topic reopened in the chat. Currently holds no information.
  - [ExGram.Model.Game](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Game.md): This object represents a game. Use BotFather to create and edit games, their short names will act as unique identifiers.

  - [ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorReverseSide](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorReverseSide.md): Represents an issue with the reverse side of a document. The error is considered resolved when the file with reverse side of the document changes.
  - [ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorSelfie](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorSelfie.md): Represents an issue with the selfie with a document. The error is considered resolved when the file with the selfie changes.
  - [ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorTranslationFile](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorTranslationFile.md): Represents an issue with one of the files that constitute the translation of a document. The error is considered resolved when the file changes.
  - [ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorTranslationFiles](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorTranslationFiles.md): Represents an issue with the translated version of a document. The error is considered resolved when a file with the document translation change.
  - [ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorUnspecified](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PassportElementErrorUnspecified.md): Represents an issue in an unspecified place. The error is considered resolved when new data is added.
  - [ExGram.Model.PassportFile](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PassportFile.md): This object represents a file uploaded to Telegram Passport. Currently all Telegram Passport files are in JPEG format when decrypted and don't exceed 10MB.
  - [ExGram.Model.PhotoSize](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PhotoSize.md): This object represents one size of a photo or a file / sticker thumbnail.
  - [ExGram.Model.Poll](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Poll.md): This object contains information about a poll.
  - [ExGram.Model.PollAnswer](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PollAnswer.md): This object represents an answer of a user in a non-anonymous poll.
  - [ExGram.Model.PollMedia](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PollMedia.md): At most one of the optional fields can be present in any given object.
  - [ExGram.Model.PollOption](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PollOption.md): This object contains information about one answer option in a poll.

  - [ExGram.Model.PreparedKeyboardButton](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.PreparedKeyboardButton.md): Describes a keyboard button to be used by a user of a Mini App.
  - [ExGram.Model.ProximityAlertTriggered](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ProximityAlertTriggered.md): This object represents the content of a service message, sent whenever a user in the chat triggers a proximity alert set by another user.
  - [ExGram.Model.ReactionCount](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ReactionCount.md): Represents a reaction added to a message along with the number of times it was added.
  - [ExGram.Model.ReactionType](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ReactionType.md): ReactionType model. Valid subtypes: ReactionTypeEmoji, ReactionTypeCustomEmoji, ReactionTypePaid

  - [ExGram.Model.ReactionTypeCustomEmoji](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ReactionTypeCustomEmoji.md): The reaction is based on a custom emoji.
  - [ExGram.Model.ReactionTypeEmoji](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ReactionTypeEmoji.md): The reaction is based on an emoji.
  - [ExGram.Model.ReactionTypePaid](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ReactionTypePaid.md): The reaction is paid.
  - [ExGram.Model.RefundedPayment](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.RefundedPayment.md): This object contains basic information about a refunded payment.
  - [ExGram.Model.ReplyKeyboardMarkup](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ReplyKeyboardMarkup.md): This object represents a custom keyboard with reply options (see Introduction to bots for details and examples). Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a business account.
  - [ExGram.Model.ReplyKeyboardRemove](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ReplyKeyboardRemove.md): Upon receiving a message with this object, Telegram clients will remove the current custom keyboard and display the default letter-keyboard. By default, custom keyboards are displayed until a new keyboard is sent by a bot. An exception is made for one-time keyboards that are hidden immediately after the user presses a button (see ReplyKeyboardMarkup). Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a business account.
  - [ExGram.Model.ReplyParameters](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ReplyParameters.md): Describes reply parameters for the message that is being sent.
  - [ExGram.Model.ResponseParameters](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.ResponseParameters.md): Describes why a request was unsuccessful.

  - [ExGram.Model.RevenueWithdrawalStateFailed](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.RevenueWithdrawalStateFailed.md): The withdrawal failed and the transaction was refunded.
  - [ExGram.Model.RevenueWithdrawalStatePending](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.RevenueWithdrawalStatePending.md): The withdrawal is in progress.

  - [ExGram.Model.Video](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Video.md): This object represents a video file.
  - [ExGram.Model.VideoChatEnded](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.VideoChatEnded.md): This object represents a service message about a video chat ended in the chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.VideoChatParticipantsInvited](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.VideoChatParticipantsInvited.md): This object represents a service message about new members invited to a video chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.VideoChatScheduled](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.VideoChatScheduled.md): This object represents a service message about a video chat scheduled in the chat.
  - [ExGram.Model.VideoChatStarted](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.VideoChatStarted.md): This object represents a service message about a video chat started in the chat. Currently holds no information.
  - [ExGram.Model.VideoNote](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.VideoNote.md): This object represents a video message (available in Telegram apps as of v.4.0).
  - [ExGram.Model.VideoQuality](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.VideoQuality.md): This object represents a video file of a specific quality.
  - [ExGram.Model.Voice](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.Voice.md): This object represents a voice note.
  - [ExGram.Model.WebAppData](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.WebAppData.md): Describes data sent from a Web App to the bot.
  - [ExGram.Model.WebAppInfo](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.WebAppInfo.md): Describes a Web App.
  - [ExGram.Model.WebhookInfo](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.WebhookInfo.md): Describes the current status of a webhook.
  - [ExGram.Model.WriteAccessAllowed](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Model.WriteAccessAllowed.md): This object represents a service message about a user allowing a bot to write messages after adding it to the attachment menu, launching a Web App from a link, or accepting an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess.

- Exceptions
  - [ExGram.Error](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/ExGram.Error.md): Error struct for representing errors in ExGram.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix bot.new](https://ex-gram.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Bot.New.md): Mix task to create a basic bot module
